IC.IC1: 1. Are referred to the Cachexia Clinic with involuntary weight loss of >5% of their premorbid weight within the previous 6 months.
IC.IC2: 2. Are 18 years of age or older
IC.IC3: 3. Have a Karnofsky performance score of 60 or higher.
IC.IC4: 4. Can maintain oral food intake during the study
IC.IC5: 5. Can understand the study procedures and can sign an informed consent form.

IC7.IC7.1: 7. Are taking megestrol acetate and continue to lose weight
IC7.IC7.2: despite at least 2 weeks of therapy.

IC.IC8: 8. Have a calculated creatinine clearance of >/= 60 cc/min.
